Confirm it with your advisor.

Students in the Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track with CGA of 3.3 or above may apply for enrollment in the History Research Option. In addition, they should take Honors Thesis or Honors Research with a primary focus in history to complete the requirement of SHSS 4992 OR (SHSS 4991 AND SHSS 4993) as specified in the major requirements.
SOSC 4290: The course was last offered in 2023-24 and was deleted subsequently.
Integrated Humanities and Social Science Track - Elective Course(s): SOSC 4290 is named in the requirement PDF but not in the 2026-27 course catalog, so it was left out of this check.
